paper.title: GraphMind: From Operational Traces to Self-Evolving Workflow Automation
paper.central_claim: GraphMind将运维轨迹转换为工作流图，经执行质量反馈强化节点/边并合成新边，使后续自治调查更少幻觉、更有效且比摘要RAG节省检索上下文。

provenance.notes: 按分配路由sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol执行；无独立可核验运行receipt/session ID，不探测模型。未运行论文代码。

sections_read: 完整HTML提取：§1–9、算法1、公式1–8、表1–4、全部图注及脚注；材料无独立附录

evidence.quote: where usefulness is LLM-judged, groundedness measures evidence support, and user feedback, when available, takes precedence. Other scoring functions can be used depending on the scenario.
evidence.support_explanation: 反馈是混合质量代理而非逐边因果收益；权重与人工反馈覆盖未具体给出。

evidence.quote: ), normalized by trajectory length to bias toward efficient sequences:
evidence.support_explanation: Q达到0.8门槛才按轨迹长度均分到访问节点和边。

evidence.quote: edge is synthesized, capturing cross-incident sequences discovered online.
evidence.support_explanation: 成功轨迹相邻未连节点被写入LEADS_TO边，形成持久结构变化。

evidence.quote: All weights are decayed at regular intervals:
evidence.support_explanation: 提出时间衰减，但核心实验关闭了衰减。

evidence.quote:
Test incidents are drawn exclusively from tickets filed
after
this date, ensuring a
strict temporal split
with no information leakage. All LLM components use GPT-5.2.
evidence.support_explanation: 离线图来源为2026年2月前1330事件，93测试事件严格较晚；不自动证明ATR沉积与测试隔离。

evidence.quote: Both systems use the same agentic orchestration loop and benefit from LLM-based preprocessing; the key difference is knowledge representation:
evidence.support_explanation: 共享编排与预处理使图对比摘要RAG更可解释，但未逐项拆分聚类、边和动态强化。

evidence.quote: As a qualitative validation, two domain experts conducted blind reviews of 19 matched incidents (the maximum feasible due to expert-availability constraints).
evidence.support_explanation: 小型独立盲评补充LLM评估；非93事件全量人工真值。

evidence.quote:
Mitigation Reach
, the fraction of incidents where the system completes its investigation with a conclusive output rather than halting prematurely;
evidence.support_explanation: 完成结论不是实际缓解/修复成功。

evidence.quote:
KQL Successes
, the number of KQL queries returning non-empty results per incident, because incorrectly targeted queries typically fail or return empty results.
evidence.support_explanation: 非空查询数量是代理，增加动作即可增加吞吐，不等于诊断正确。

evidence.quote: We evolve the workflow graph over six reinforcement epochs (15 traversal trajectories each).
evidence.support_explanation: 90轨迹产生289边；rho=alpha=0的演化实验不验证衰减或加权采样。

evidence.quote: on 163 recent incidents across 8 runs (4 per condition)
evidence.support_explanation: 有保留强化对照，163事件四次/条件；未说明冻结图/沉积任务ID及任务重叠审计。

evidence.quote:
Although confidence intervals overlap for some individual metrics, improvements are
directionally consistent
across all four metrics and all four independent runs per condition, indicating a robust signal rather than statistical noise.
evidence.support_explanation: 报告重复与区间，但方向一致不等于显著；不接受其排除噪声的强表述。

evidence.quote: : reinforced traversal explores more paths and executes more actions, resulting in approximately 8% higher end-to-end latency on average and on average 1.5 more rounds of investigation.
evidence.support_explanation: 强化更贵，更多探索是替代解释；不重复计入measurement。
报告构图成本与延迟，但无完整强化沉积/维护总账和预算匹配曲线。

evidence.quote: Among the 62 scored conversations, 97% yield actionable output, validating that offline evaluation gains translate to real-world triage workflows.
evidence.support_explanation: 97%仅62个已评分子集；143本地会话中81未评分，不是整体成功率。

signatures.object: 跨事件工作流图节点/边及其强化权重
signatures.information: 人类解决轨迹、在线诊断动作和观测、LLM usefulness/groundedness及可用用户反馈
signatures.operation: 抽取/规范化/聚类domain-problem-action图→在线检索执行→Q>=0.8按轨迹均分沉积→成功相邻未连节点合成边→可选时间衰减
signatures.output: 带强化权重、去重节点及新LEADS_TO边的持久图
signatures.conditions: 轨迹质量代理可信；非空查询与支持性观测可供诊断；不同事件可复用操作
signatures.feedback: Q是混合代理，不是单边反事实收益
signatures.selection_rule/data: 质量>=0.8；每个轨迹元素分Q/|T|，未达到门槛不沉积；用户反馈可用时优先
signatures.persistence: 图数据库中的节点/边/phi；增量聚类可恢复原始节点再合并
signatures.later_use: Graph Loader按log(1+phi)^alpha扩展；节点phi进入Action Planner软先验
signatures.claimed_effect: 减少幻觉，发现跨事件路径，提升后续调查
signatures.failure_boundary: 自评错误、均分错误信用、热点过度集中、图覆盖/权限/过期遥测；主演化实验rho=alpha=0不验证实际衰减

gap.author_gap: 扁平事件摘要缺少跨事件因果和操作顺序，静态图不能从自治执行持续适应。
gap.checked_gap: 摘要RAG在相同编排中有更大上下文且质量较低；ATR权重去除对照支持一小部分后续收益。图结构总体贡献强于自演化收益，不能把两者混为一谈。

lineage/closest_adjacent.name: Ant Colony Optimization
lineage/closest_adjacent.relationship: 成功路径沉积与时间蒸发的直接算法谱系；不是新优化原理。

lineage/closest_adjacent.name: GraphRAG / Agentic Summary-RAG / Trace2Skill / AIOps incident agents
lineage/closest_adjacent.source_version: 本文v2 §2与§6.2；未提供邻文原稿
lineage/closest_adjacent.relationship: 图检索、跨事件经验组织和操作复用最近邻，不能仅以实体图静态来排除全部已有动态图方法。

gap.residue: 操作级去重图加执行轨迹强化，可检验的新增部分是权重/边在后续事件中是否比相同预算静态图更有效。
gap.stakes: 真实生产运维中噪声、过期证据与昂贵调查影响工程师决策。
gap.method_response: 三类节点四类关系压缩经验，迭代检索与执行获得反馈，ATR改变后续可达路径与排序。
gap.remaining_gap: 缺图边合成vs强化权重分离、负强化、真实漂移衰减、预算匹配，以及严格沉积/选参/测试关系。
